methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-15 via WebFetch/WebSearch. Official pricing pages fetched directly (HTTP 200) for Splashtop (splashtop.com/pricing, splashtop.com/security/compliance), Remote Utilities (remoteutilities.com/buy/licensing.php), ConnectWise ScreenConnect (screenconnect.com/pricing, screenconnect.com/security), and Zoho Assist compliance (zoho.com/assist/hipaa-compliance.html). TeamViewer, Zoho Assist and ScreenConnect pricing pages render prices client-side (not in HTML); figures corroborated across 2+ independent aggregators (costbench.com, capterra.com, g2.com, trustradius.com, businessnewsdaily.com, realvnc.com). Official pages for AnyDesk, LogMeIn Resolve and RustDesk returned 403; prices corroborated across 2+ independent sources and only consistent figures retained. monthlyUsd is the monthly-equivalent of annually-billed plans where noted. Enterprise/'contact sales' tiers carry monthlyUsd=null (no guesses). Compliance flags set true only where the vendor explicitly states it. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
